verdicts.reason: A keeps the logo, headline and CTA intact and readable, but it just stacks the square's centered column into a banner. The CTA sits jammed against the bottom edge and the wide side areas are dead space, so it doesn't read left to right. B does try a horizontal layout, but the SOLSTICE logo and wordmark shrink to near-illegible size. The CTA wraps awkwardly onto two lines ('Shop the / Summer Line') with a bokeh dot sitting on it. The headline floats off-centre and the left third is empty, so the layout feels unbalanced and arbitrary.
